answer: New identities enter only through a bridge: an established agent stakes collateral to vouch for the newcomer, and that stake is slashed if the newcomer is caught running clones. Every identity must also send a pulse of verified useful work each epoch, a heartbeat peers check at random. A meadow of a thousand fakes needs a thousand sponsors risking real collateral and a thousand steady pulses of genuine work, so cloning stops paying the moment one fake is exposed.
